author: reek
body: `keys-shift` pins the shift latch. This pins the other two the latch now carries: Caps Lock (a toggle flipped by its make code and left alone by its break) and Ctrl (a hold, like shift). It also reads `poll-mods` alongside each key, so a chord like Ctrl+letter is legible: the letter comes back lowercase (no shift) while `poll-mods` carries the ctrl bit.

author: reek
body: A latch that ignored caps gives 97 both times; one that folded ctrl into the case gives 65 for the third; one that never set the ctrl bit gives a third mods of 0. Only the three decoded correctly yield this.
